newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan Sept forex reserves down at $1.865 bln.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan Sept forex reserves down at $1.865 bln.

text.p: Pakistan's foreign exchange reserves fell to $1.865 billion in September from $2.344 billion in August, and compared to $2.287 billion in September 1995, the State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Wednesday.
The central bank gave no reason for the fall.
A foreign banker said debt repayments scheduled in September and higher imports might have pulled the reserves down.
The reserves included $569 million held in Pakistan and $560 million outside Pakistan, the bank said.
